title: Brand of T (PORT) is inferior and oddly sized.  See below.
text: Disappointed in the brand of T used because that brand runs very small and short.  I ordered a large -- fits like a medium and both the shirt and sleeves are short.  Other T"s I have in a large measure 2" longer (measured center back from just below neck band to hem.  In addition the sleeves are 1-1/2" shorter (measuring the underarm seam from arm hole to the hem of the sleeve compared to a Canvas or Gildan brand T).  The sleeves look STUPID.  This lack of length of the T isn't a problem for me because I am 5'1" but look out tall people.  Another Amazon review indicated the shirts ran small so I ordered a lg instead of medium.  I have purchased other shirts made from this brand and that is just how the brand fits.  Amazon you SHOULD do better.  Any time I receive a shirt using the PORT brand, it will be returned immediately.  BTW, I CANCELLED MY MEMBERSHIP TO THE PEANUTS VAULT DESIGN CLUB AS THE SHIRTS ARE SIMPLY UNWEARABLE.  A BIG LET DOWN.
label: negative
